verdict.rationale: ClickUp's Brain² marketing says you can ask complex questions and it checks your workspace tasks, docs, conversations, connected apps and the web for answers, so the core Q&A-over-workspace capability is claimed. Nothing in the evidence shows answers come with citations or source links back to workspace items, and there is no hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: documented citations/source attribution in answers, evidence of answer speed, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing copy.
